Deux points d'entrée : `@ix-xs/youtube.api` fonctionne partout où `fetch` existe, `@ix-xs/youtube.api/node` regroupe les quelques fonctions qui ont besoin de Node.js lui-même. Les descriptions viennent des commentaires du code source, en anglais comme dans votre éditeur.

## Classes

| Nom | Ce que c'est |
| --- | --- |
| `Analytics` | `yt.analytics`: the YouTube Analytics API. |
| `Channels` | `yt.channels`: the raw `channels` methods, plus helpers that accept a channel in any form: an id, an `@handle`, a legacy username or a URL. |
| `Comments` | `yt.comments`: the raw methods, plus shortcuts for replies. |
| `CommentThreads` | `yt.commentThreads`: the raw methods, plus shortcuts for the comments of a video. |
| `ListRequest` | What every `list` method returns. |
| `LiveChat` | One live chat: read it, write to it, moderate it. |
| `LiveChatMessages` | `yt.liveChatMessages`: the raw methods, plus the streaming variant of `list`. |
| `MemoryCache` | In-memory store that drops the least recently used entry once full. |
| `OAuth2` | OAuth 2.0 for the YouTube APIs: consent URL, code exchange, automatic refresh, revocation and the device flow. |
| `Page` | One page of results. |
| `Playlists` | `yt.playlists`: the raw `playlists` methods, plus helpers that accept a playlist id or URL and take care of the playlist items for you. |
| `QuotaTracker` | Counts the quota this client spends. |
| `Reporting` | `yt.reporting`: the YouTube Reporting API, which delivers bulk reports as daily CSV files. |
| `Search` | `yt.search`: the raw `search.list`, plus one helper per result type whose results are typed accordingly. |
| `Subscriptions` | `yt.subscriptions`: the raw methods, plus subscribe and unsubscribe by channel. |
| `Videos` | `yt.videos`: the raw `videos` methods, plus helpers that accept a video id or any video URL (watch page, `youtu.be`, Shorts, live, embed). |
| `Watcher` | Watches channels for new uploads and tells you when one appears. |
| `YouTube` | The YouTube client. |
| `YouTubeApiError` | The API answered with an error status. |
| `YouTubeArgumentError` | The library itself refused something: an argument that cannot be right, or a reference that matched nothing (a handle with no channel, a video with no live chat). |
| `YouTubeAuthError` | Credentials are missing, insufficient, or an OAuth exchange failed. |
| `YouTubeError` | Base class of everything thrown by this library. |
| `YouTubeQuotaBudgetError` | The call would go over the quota budget configured on the client. |
| `YouTubeRequestError` | The request never produced a usable response: timeout, network failure, abort or unreadable body. |
| `YouTubeUploadError` | An upload could not be completed. |

| Nom | Ce que c'est |
| --- | --- |
| `bestThumbnail` | Picks the largest thumbnail of a `snippet.thumbnails` object. |

| `feedUrl` | URL of the public feed of a channel (`UC...`) or a playlist. |

| `formatDuration` | Formats a duration for display. |

| `isPlaylistId` | Whether a string looks like a playlist id. |
| `isVideoId` | Whether a string looks like a video id (11 URL-safe characters). |
| `isYouTubeError` | Type guard for errors thrown by this library, optionally narrowed to a code. |
| `nextQuotaReset` | Next midnight Pacific Time, when YouTube resets daily quotas. |
| `oEmbed` | Fetches the title, author, thumbnail and embed code of a video or playlist URL, with no API key and no quota. |
| `parseChannelRef` | Works out what a channel reference is: an id, a handle, a legacy username or a URL of any style. |
| `parseDuration` | Converts an ISO 8601 duration, the format of `contentDetails.duration`, to seconds. |
| `parseFeed` | Parses the XML of a YouTube feed. |
| `parseUrl` | Reads a YouTube URL. |
| `playlistIdFrom` | Extracts a playlist id from an id or a URL that carries a `list` parameter. |
| `quotaCost` | Quota cost of a method, in units, and the bucket it is charged to. |
| `scopeName` | Shortens a scope URL to the name used in the API reference. |
| `scopeUrl` | Expands a short scope name to the URL Google expects. |
| `videoIdFrom` | Extracts a video id from an id or any video URL. |

## `@ix-xs/youtube.api/node`

| Nom | Ce que c'est |
| --- | --- |
| `authorize` | Runs the whole consent flow on this machine, for scripts and command-line tools: starts a local server, opens the consent page, waits for Google to come back with the code and trades it for tokens. |
| `AuthorizeOptions` | Options of `authorize`. |
| `fileMedia` | Prepares a file on disk for upload, without reading it into memory. |
| `tokenFile` | Keeps OAuth tokens in a JSON file. |
| `webSubListener` | Turns `websub.receive` into a listener for `node:http`, Express, Fastify's raw mode and anything else built on Node's request and response objects. |
| `WebSubListenerOptions` | Options of `webSubListener`. |

## Types générés

Ils viennent de la description de l'API publiée par Google et en reprennent les noms.

### Ressources

26 ressources se lisent par `part`. Chacune a trois types : `Video<"snippet" | "statistics">` est la ressource réduite à ces parties, `VideoPart` est l'union des noms de ses parties, et `VideoResource` est la ressource complète, toutes parties optionnelles (`Video` seul veut dire la même chose).

`Activity`, `Caption`, `Channel`, `ChannelSection`, `Comment`, `CommentThread`, `I18nLanguage`, `I18nRegion`, `LiveBroadcast`, `LiveChatBan`, `LiveChatMessage`, `LiveChatModerator`, `LiveStream`, `Member`, `MembershipsLevel`, `Playlist`, `PlaylistImage`, `PlaylistItem`, `SearchResult`, `Subscription`, `SuperChatEvent`, `ThirdPartyLink`, `Video`, `VideoAbuseReportReason`, `VideoCategory`, `VideoStat`

### Autres schémas

250 interfaces décrivent tout le reste de ce que l'API envoie ou accepte : les parties elles-mêmes (`VideoSnippet`, `ChannelStatistics`), les réponses de liste (`VideoListResponse`) et les objets imbriqués (`Thumbnail`, `ResourceId`). Les types des API Analytics et Reporting portent le préfixe `Analytics` ou `Reporting`.

### Paramètres

Une interface par méthode, nommée d'après elle : `VideosListParams`, `PlaylistItemsInsertParams`, `AnalyticsGroupsListParams`. Il y en a 98.

### Classes de méthodes

35 classes portent les méthodes de chaque ressource, comme `PlaylistItemsApi` derrière `yt.playlistItems`. Vous y accédez par le client et les nommez rarement. `MethodId` est l'union de tous les noms de méthodes.
